title: 24-hour ice test

concept.angle: A3 — warm water ruins long days

hook.vo: We left it in a hot car for a full day.
hook.visual: ice rattles as the bottle is shaken toward camera

beats: 5-10s payoff: pour, ice cubes still clinking
10-13s CTA: send this to the friend who drinks warm water
concept.send_test: Gym-goer sends it to the friend who always complains their water gets warm

product_descriptor: matte sage-green 750 ml stainless-steel bottle with white 'NOVA' wordmark and bamboo screw cap

keyframe.prompt: Place the bottle from image 2 upright on the sunny car dashboard in image 1, hard afternoon sunlight from the left, heat haze, shallow depth of field, shot on a phone

video.prompt: Vertical 9:16 close-up, handheld micro-jitter. 0-1s: a hand grabs the bottle and shakes it toward camera, ice rattles. 1-4s: slow push-in as the bottle settles back on the dashboard. The matte sage-green NOVA bottle stays rigid; label and logo unchanged. Hard afternoon light, photoreal phone footage.
video.negative_prompt: morphing, warped label, extra fingers, distorted hands, melting, flicker, text, subtitles, watermark, logo changes

keyframe.prompt: Same bottle being poured into a clear glass on a kitchen counter, ice cubes visible in the stream, condensation on the bottle, morning window light

video.prompt: Vertical close-up, locked-off camera. 0-3s: water and ice cubes pour from the bottle into the glass, cubes clink. 3-5s: glass fills, condensation drips. Bottle shape, label and logo unchanged. Photoreal.

voiceover.script: We left it in a hot car for a full day. Forty-one degrees on the dash. And the ice? Still there. Send this to the friend who drinks warm water.

generate.prompt: minimal upbeat electronic, bright plucks and claps, 112 bpm, energy lift at 6 s, instrumental
short airy whoosh transition, clean, no reverb tail

tiktok.caption: insulated water bottle ice test: 24 hours in a hot car

instagram.caption: Insulated water bottle vs. a full day in a hot car. Send this to the friend who drinks warm water.
instagram.alt_text: Green steel bottle on a sunny car dashboard, then pouring water with ice into a glass

x.text: We left it in a hot car for 24 hours. The ice survived. Would yours?
x.reply: Tested at 41°C on the dash. Full test details in our pinned post.
